title: 第15章 神兽指点第16章 赶出去
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
日光猫无法自控地吼叫着，他有些激动地在最高层旋转跳跃了一会。
激动过后。
他想起了什么，不由兴奋地向下看去：“媳妇，这上面……”
然后，他就对上了一双无比冷冽的目光。
“这上面怎么了？”月光猫平静地看着他。
日光猫吓得浑身哆嗦了一下，他连滚带爬地冲了下来，一脸讨好地凑了过来：“这上面挺舒服的，正适合你晚上吸收月光的时候用。”
月光猫嫌弃地看了他一眼，淡然说道：“也就那样。”
生怕日光猫露出更丢脸的模样来，月光猫看了一眼宋荞，淡然说道：“行了，你们的今天的活儿，就到这里吧。”
“是。”宋荞笑眯眯地应了下来。
黎漠老实行了个礼，他还要说些场面话再走，宋荞已经一把将他拉走。
黎漠不由说道：“宋师妹，这不合礼数，这是神兽大人，我们应该……”
“大师兄，你觉得神兽大人为什么急着赶我们走？”宋荞说道。
黎漠皱了皱眉头：“许是嫌我们烦了。”
宋荞忍不住翻了个白眼，然后说道：“我们不走，月光猫大人怎么能安心到猫爬架……不对，大树上玩耍？”
黎漠：“？？？”
“快走吧。”宋荞拉着黎漠，就加快了速度。
黎漠一路都是一副怀疑人生的模样。
在宋荞的解读下，他总觉得，神兽大人怎么和他想象中，完全不同了！
“荞荞，爷爷来救你了！”
两人刚走出一段路，一道视死如归的声音响了起来。

宋方用他最快的速度，直愣愣地朝里飞了过去。
然后，他就看见了毫发无伤正从里头出来的宋荞。
宋方：“？？？”
宋荞：“？？？”
“谁敢擅闯！”一道冷冽的声音响了起来。
下一秒，一轮圆月浮现空中，霜冷的寒意，直接锁定宋方。
宋荞神情顿时变了。爷爷不知为何突然闯了过来，神兽大人这是发怒了！
宋荞心头一慌，赶忙说道：“神兽大人，这是我爷爷，他可能以为我出了什么事，这才匆匆来寻我。还请神兽大人，饶他一次。”
整片天地都寂静了一会。
下一瞬间。
圆月缓缓消失，月光猫的声音响了起来：“下不为例。”
“是。”宋荞赶忙应了下来。
她看宋方一副傻愣愣的样子，赶忙拉着他，离开后山区域。
“荞荞，你……你没事？”宋方一脸惊奇地看着宋荞。
宋荞何止是没事！
要知道，月光猫是出了名的脾气差，自己擅闯后山，就已经做好了身死道消的准备。
结果，宋荞一句话，月光猫竟然就轻轻放过了他？
“我能有什么事！”宋荞不由说道：“爷爷，你没事做闯后山干什么？”
宋方挠了挠头：“我以为……我以为……”
“以为我出事了？”宋荞不由瞪了他一眼：“我这么聪明可爱，能出什么事？神兽一见到我，就喜欢得不得了好吗？”

宋方顿时嘿嘿笑了起来：“那就好……那就好……”
“黎师兄，那我先和爷爷回去了。我们明天见。”宋荞转身说道。
content_en:
The Sunlight Cat roared uncontrollably, and he spun and jumped on the top floor with some excitement.
After the excitement.
He remembered something and couldn't help but look down excitedly: "Daughter-in-law, up here..."
Then, he met a pair of extremely cold eyes.
"What's going on here?" Moonlight Cat looked at him calmly.
The Sunlight Cat was so frightened that he trembled all over. He rolled down and came over with a flattering look on his face: "It's quite comfortable up here, just right for you to use when you absorb the moonlight at night."
Moonlight Cat glanced at him with disgust and said calmly: "That's it."
Afraid that the Sunlight Cat would show an even more embarrassing look, the Moonlight Cat glanced at Song Qiao and said calmly: "Okay, your work for today will end here."
"Yes." Song Qiao responded with a smile.
Li Molao saluted, and he wanted to say some polite words before leaving, but Song Qiao had already pulled him away.
Li Mo couldn't help but said: "Junior sister Song, this is not etiquette. This is the sacred beast. We should..."
"Elder brother, why do you think the sacred beast is in such a hurry to drive us away?" Song Qiao said.
Li Mo frowned: "Maybe he thinks we are annoyed."
Song Qiao couldn't help but rolled his eyes, and then said: "If we don't leave, how can Mr. Moonlight Cat safely go to the cat climbing frame... no, play on the big tree?"
Li Mo: "???"
"Let's go quickly." Song Qiao pulled Li Mo and speeded up.
Li Mo looked suspicious of life all the way.
Under Song Qiao's interpretation, he always felt that the mythical beast was completely different from what he imagined!
"Buckwheat, grandpa is here to save you!"
The two of them had just walked some distance when a voice sounded as if they were dying.
Song Fang used his fastest speed and flew straight in.
Then, he saw Song Qiao coming out unharmed.
Song Fang: "???"
Song Qiao: "???"
"Who dares to trespass!" A cold voice rang.
The next second, a full moon appeared in the sky, and the frosty chill directly locked onto Song Fang.
Song Qiao's expression suddenly changed. Grandpa suddenly came over for some reason, and the mythical beast was angry!
Song Qiao panicked and said quickly: "Master Divine Beast, this is my grandfather. He may have thought something happened to me, so he came to look for me in a hurry. Please forgive him once, Master Divine Beast."
The whole world was silent for a while.
The next moment.
The full moon slowly disappeared, and Moonlight Cat's voice rang out: "It won't happen again."
"Yes." Song Qiao responded quickly.
Seeing Song Fang's dumbfounded look, she quickly pulled him away from the back mountain area.
"Qiao Qiao, you...are you okay?" Song Fang looked at Song Qiao in surprise.
Song Qiao was fine!
You know, Moonlight Cat is famous for his bad temper. If he breaks into the back mountain without permission, he is already prepared to die.
As a result, with Song Qiao's words, Moonlight Cat let him go?
"What can happen to me!" Song Qiao couldn't help but said: "Grandpa, why are you going to the back mountain when you have nothing to do?"
Song Fang scratched his head: "I thought... I thought..."
"Think something happened to me?" Song Qiao couldn't help but glared at him: "I'm so smart and cute, what could happen? The mythical beast fell in love with me as soon as it saw me, okay?"
Song Fang suddenly laughed: "That's good...that's good..."
"Senior Brother Li, I'll go back with grandpa first. We'll see you tomorrow." Song Qiao turned around and said.
